# Sam Osborne

> Sam Osborne is a trained Demartini Method Facilitator and a keynote speaker on conflict and composure, based in Los Angeles (Burbank, California). He gives keynotes and workshops for attorneys, financial advisors, executives, and sales teams, and works privately by video with accomplished professionals in 10 countries. He was previously known online as "Self Worth Sam." His work is educational facilitation, not therapy.

## Private sessions
- [Private Demartini Method Sessions](https://samosborne.net/private-sessions): One-to-one sessions by video for professionals held back by impostor syndrome, self-doubt, guilt, or one person they can't stop reacting to. Breakthrough Session $1,100; Six-Session Program $4,500. Starts with a free 20-minute fit call.
- [Leadership Advisory](https://samosborne.net/leadership-advisory): Private facilitation for leaders in high-stakes roles.

## Speaking
- [Keynotes: The Conflict Advantage](https://samosborne.net/): Conflict and composure keynotes that include a live on-stage demonstration with a volunteer.
- [Program formats](https://samosborne.net/programs): Keynote, breakout, half-day workshop, and multi-session formats for meeting planners.
- [Composure Through Conflict](https://samosborne.net/composure-through-conflict): Program co-presented with David Graf.
